Package com.hiface.sdk.search

Class InfraredSearchConfig

java.lang.Object
com.hiface.sdk.search.InfraredSearchConfig
public final class InfraredSearchConfig extends java.lang.Object
Device settings for single-person RGB identity search with IR liveness. RGB passive liveness is not run when this mode is enabled.

Calibrate thresholds for the camera module, lighting, and actual attack samples. Model scores are not accuracy percentages. The normalized mapping checks geometric correspondence between RGB and IR face boxes; it does not prove that both spectra show the same identity or replace synchronized hardware exposure.

  • Constructor Details

    • InfraredSearchConfig

      public InfraredSearchConfig(float realThreshold, @NonNull float[] normalizedRgbToIr, float minimumFaceOverlap, int minimumFacePixels, int maxPairSkewMillis, int maxFrameAgeMillis)
      Parameters:
      realThreshold - required IR liveness threshold; recommended 0.80–0.99, starting at 0.90; accepts values greater than 0 and at most 1
      normalizedRgbToIr - row-major 3 x 3 homography from rotated, unmirrored RGB to IR normalized coordinates; divide x by the corresponding image width and y by its height
      minimumFaceOverlap - minimum overlap (IoU) between the mapped RGB box and IR box, in (0,1]
      minimumFacePixels - minimum IR face width and height, 10..4096 pixels; RGB retains its 100-pixel minimum
      maxPairSkewMillis - maximum timestamp difference between the cameras, 1..200 milliseconds
      maxFrameAgeMillis - maximum age of both frames when accepting an IR sample, maxPairSkewMillis..1000 milliseconds
